newsitem.title: USA: Duty free millionaire donated $600 mln - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Duty free millionaire donated $600 mln - NYT.

text.p: Duty free millionaire Charles Feeney quietly gave away more than $600 million to hospitals, universities, Sinn Fein and others over the last 15 years, the New York Times reported on Thursday.
Feeney, whose personal fortune has been estimated in the billions, has given most of his assets to his two charitable foundations and is worth less than $5 million, the paper said.
Feeney's decision to disclose his gifts came after he sold his empire to France's LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton this month.
The New York Times said Feeney agreed to discuss his donations because a lawsuit over the sale would have revealed his anonymous gifts.
